# Equity Partners

> Equity Partners (Andorra Property Group) is an Andorra-based real estate investment group that gives international investors institutional-grade access to the Principality's high-barrier property market — from full-cycle project development to debt and equity investment opportunities.

Equity Partners bridges international capital into Andorran real estate. Every opportunity is open to three investment structures: Debt (contractual annual income, lowest risk), Debt + Equity (recurring coupon plus equity profit share at exit — the structure most investors choose), and Equity (full project upside, longest hold). Returns are calibrated per project and shared on a video call. The firm is based in Andorra la Vella and operates in English, Spanish and Catalan.

## Investment structures
- Debt — predictable annual coupon, senior secured, lowest risk, no project upside.
- Debt + Equity — recurring coupon plus an equity profit share at exit (most commonly chosen).
- Equity — full ownership stake and profit share at exit, highest return potential, longest hold.

## Investment opportunities (illustrative examples)
- [Project Andorra la Vella](https://equitypartners.fund/opportunities/project-andorra-la-vella): Stabilised, income-producing commercial asset in the capital (Debt).
- [Project Ordino](https://equitypartners.fund/opportunities/project-ordino): Boutique mountain lodge near the Ordino-Arcalís ski area (Debt + Equity).
- [Project Escaldes](https://equitypartners.fund/opportunities/project-escaldes): Landmark luxury residential development in Escaldes-Engordany (Equity).
- [Project Canillo](https://equitypartners.fund/opportunities/project-canillo): Branded boutique hotel at the gateway to Soldeu–El Tarter (Debt + Equity).
- [Project La Massana](https://equitypartners.fund/opportunities/project-la-massana): Boutique alpine residences near the Pal Arinsal gondola (Debt + Equity).
